title: gateway: dev() rollback-root independence check lives only in lichend, not in Gateway::new_persistent
description: Found by 3x codereview of the recipient-store heal (9liz), security pass (informational). The anti-rollback design relies on the floor root being on a filesystem independent of the state root; the enforcement (dev() comparison) exists only in the lichend binary (rust/lichen-gateway/src/bin/lichend.rs:1408-1425). Gateway::new_persistent (rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:915-928) checks only canonicalize/nesting, so another embedder of the library constructor silently skips the check, collapsing the mitigation to directory separation. Promote the dev() independence check into Gateway::new_persistent (return GatewayOpenError) or a new constructor, keep the binary call site.
